name: Detección de Filtrado Mediano
description: Detecta traces of median filtering applied to suppress JPEG artefactos and hide alteración evidence.
algorithm: Median Filtered Image Forensics via First-Digit Analysis
mechanism: Analiza pixel value distribucións para detectar the smoothing artefactos characteristic of median filtering. Median filtering removes high-frequency noise but leaves detectable traces in the histograma and pixel co-occurrence matrices.
parameters: Window sizes: 3×3, 5×5, 7×7; Feature: histograma bin análisis, pixel autocorrelación, streak análisis
source: Kirchner, M. & Fridrich, J. (2010) — On Detection of Median Filtering in Digital Images, SPIE Electronic Imaging
useCase: Detecting anti-forense median filtering used to conceal manipulación de imagen or AI generation traces

references.title: Kirchner, M. & Fridrich, J. (2010) — On Detection of Median Filtering in Digital Images, SPIE Electronic Imaging

strengths:
• Robust detección of median filtering traces
• Works a través de different window sizes
• Effective anti-forense countermeasure
• Low falso positivo rate
limitations:
• Cannot detect very light filtering
• May confuse with other smoothing filters
• Requires sufficient image resolución
• Performance degrades with heavy compresión JPEG
